blocks.text: Formulating research inquiries is the process of creating questions that guide your research. These questions help you focus on what you want to learn and find answers to. There are different types of research questions, and knowing how to create clear and effective questions is essential for good research.
Objective: Help students practice formulating research questions and hypotheses.

items: Choose a topic you are curious about (e.g., the impact of diet on student energy levels, the influence of extracurricular activities on grades, etc.).
Write a specific research question related to your topic.
Based on your question, develop a hypothesis that you could test through research.
Share your question and hypothesis with the class and discuss how you might design a study to answer it.

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text:
Did you know that formulating good research questions is the first step to a successful research project? A well-thought-out question sets the direction for your entire study and helps you focus on finding the right answers.

Note that by learning how to ask the right questions and making informed guesses, you can design meaningful research projects that contribute to our understanding of the world!
